pet_notes: Chibi feminine anime AI-agent operator. Long silver-blue hair, crystalline blue eyes, navy-black high-neck outfit with sparse gold constellation stitching, small metallic bell hair ornament, and one compact luminous blue constellation orb held close to the body as an identity prop. Calm, capable, slightly mysterious. Keep the same face, hair silhouette, outfit, bell, and attached orb across every state; simplify fine ornamentation for 192x208 readability.
